blocks.text: UAAP SCHEDULE: Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas isn’t choosing sides, while playing the waiting game. The Growling Tigers kept their season alive on Wednesday night after forcing a playoff for the last Final Four berth against the loser of Saturday’s clash between defending champion La Salle and Far Eastern University. “I’m sure they were praying for a UST loss the same way we were praying for La Salle and FEU to lose, but at least now, we’re not going to choose anyone,” said assistant coach Peter Martin after the Tigers’ 76-63 victory over the […]...
